description: Charts by Szum helps ChatGPT turn plain-language requests and raw data into polished charts. Explore curated themes and examples, validate chart definitions, and display interactive previews with SVG and PNG image links. Save results for permanent image and interactive embed links, then reopen, update, rename, or delete charts from ChatGPT or Szum Studio. Useful for reports, presentations, product work, and dashboards.

defaultPrompt: create a polished editorial bar chart showing quarterly revenue of $1.2M, $1.8M, $2.4M, and $2.1M, with direct value labels.
show me my five most recently saved charts and display the newest one.
find my most recently published chart and change its theme to clean while keeping its existing public links.
